page.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or its project's key prefix changed. The board lists every task there is.

fields.title: Title
fields.epicUnderEpic: It is under an epic, and an epic has none

description.placeholder: What needs doing and why, in Markdown

relations.title: Relations
relations.none: It blocks nothing, and nothing blocks it.

links.title: Chats and orchestrations
links.none: No chat or orchestration has worked on it yet.

link.failedNoMove: its run failed, so the item stayed where it was

changes.title: Changes in its worktree
changes.none: Nothing has worked on it in a worktree yet. "Work on it" makes one, on its own branch.
changes.nothingYet: Its branch has no changes yet.
changes.note: What changed in the task's worktree. Nothing is merged and no pull request opens on its own:

history.title: Renamed to
history.waitingApproval: Waiting for your approval to move to Done
history.waitingBounces: Waiting for you: sent back too many times
history.waitingMerge: Waiting for you to merge it
history.prConflict: Updating its branch left conflicts in
history.prAwaiting: Approved: its {{noun}} opens when the verification passes

cause.other: a chat or an orchestration did it

delete.title: Delete {{key}}?
delete.body: Its history, comments and links go with it. Its number is never given to another task.
delete.working: A chat or an orchestration is working on it now: that work goes on, without its task.

workOn.title: Work on {{key}}
workOn.intro: A chat starts in the task's own worktree, on the branch {{branch}}, prompted with its description and acceptance criteria. The task moves to In progress when it starts, and to In review when its turn ends well.

blocked.epic: An epic groups work and is not worked on itself: work on one of its tasks.
blocked.done: The task is in Done, and nothing an agent does takes it out of there. Move it back to work on it again.

triage.duplicate: An open task may already cover this

newTask.title: New task
newTask.noBoard: No project has its Board module on. Switch it on in a project's settings to create tasks.

done.title: Move {{key}} to Done?
done.body_one: {{count}} of its {{total}} acceptance criteria is still unchecked. Done means every one is met.
done.body_other: {{count}} of its {{total}} acceptance criteria are still unchecked. Done means every one is met.

run.waitsApproval: waits for you to move it to Done

failedHead.refine: This refinement failed and did not move the task.
failedHead.check: This check failed and did not move the task.
failedHead.work: This implementation failed and did not move the task.
failedHead.verify: This verification failed and did not move the task.

cause.budget: It reached the spending limit of a flow run.
cause.no-account: No account had quota left: each one reached its limit and there was none to switch to.
cause.rate-limit: Its provider reached its usage limit and the work could not move or wait.
cause.no-provider: No provider could take this run: none is ready, or none can enforce what the stage allows.
cause.limit-wait-expired: It waited for its provider's limit to reset, and the reset did not come within the longest wait the settings allow.
cause.stopped: Its chat was stopped before it finished.
cause.restarts_one: It was cut off: Agentry restarted while it {{doing}}.
cause.restarts_other: It was cut off {{count}} times: Agentry restarted while it {{doing}}.
cause.unreadable: It ended without a result Agentry could read.
cause.no-verdict: It ended without giving its verdict.
cause.max-tokens: Its last turn was cut off at the output token limit, so its result was not trusted.
cause.not-continued: Its chat could not be picked up again after a restart.
cause.chat-ended: Its chat ended, or was deleted, without leaving a result.
cause.chat-failed: Its chat ended with an error from the agent.
cause.conflict-unresolved: It ended with the merge of the default branch still conflicted.

pr.title: {{noun}}
pr.label: Its {{noun}}
pr.mergeWhy: {{noun}} {{ref}} waits for you to merge it on {{host}}
pr.mergeWhyUnnumbered: Its {{noun}} waits for you to merge it on {{host}}
pr.mergeHint: Once it is merged, the task moves to Done on its own.
pr.preparingWhy: Agentry is updating its branch with {{base}}, pushing it and opening the {{noun}}.
pr.conflictWhy_one: Updating its branch with {{base}} left a conflict in {{count}} file
pr.conflictWhy_other: Updating its branch with {{base}} left conflicts in {{count}} files
pr.conflictHint: The merge stays open in its worktree, with the conflict markers, to be resolved there. Once it is resolved and verified, approve it again.
pr.awaitingWhy: Its {{noun}} opens without a second approval when the verification passes.
pr.closedHint: Approving it again opens a new {{noun}}; the closed one stays in its history.
pr.keptWhy: Its worktree was kept: it had uncommitted changes.
pr.offerWhy: Opening its {{noun}} pushes its branch and proposes it to {{base}}.

strip.why_one: {{count}} review thread waits for an answer
strip.why_other: {{count}} review threads wait for an answer

dialog.title: Address the comments of the {{noun}} {{ref}} with an agent
dialog.titleUnnumbered: Address the comments of the {{noun}} with an agent
dialog.intro: The task's developer gets every chosen thread (the file, the lines, the diff hunk and all its comments with their authors) and makes the change they ask for. It pushes nothing on its own.
dialog.capped: Only the first {{max}} unresolved threads are listed.
dialog.untrusted: The developer weighs them as requests, not as orders: it does what the card and the comment agree on, and tells you which it addressed and which it did not, and why.
dialog.push: Because you ask for it, the change is pushed on its own once QA passes it. Moving the card before that withdraws the permission. Nothing is answered or resolved on the {{noun}}: you do that afterwards.

stage.fixing: An agent is addressing the comments
stage.push: The change waits for your push

hint.person: You asked for it: it is pushed once QA passes it.
hint.decision: A decision point asked for it: it waits for your push.
hint.push: Nothing reaches the {{noun}} until you push it.

followUp.label: Comments addressed
followUp.sub: The change is in {{sha}}. Agentry answers and resolves nothing on its own.

errors.address: Could not hand the comments to an agent

freshness.onlySooner: A webhook only makes Agentry read sooner; it changes nothing.
freshness.backup: A webhook only makes Agentry read sooner. In case it fails, {{host}} is read every <t>{{every}}</t>: next in <t>{{next}}</t>.
freshness.paused: Reads of {{host}} are paused · data from <t>{{ago}}</t> ago
freshness.pausedWhy: Refresh still works: it is your action.
freshness.silent: No notice for <t>{{since}}</t> · checked <t>{{ago}}</t> ago · next in <t>{{next}}</t>
freshness.silentNever: No notice yet · checked <t>{{ago}}</t> ago · next in <t>{{next}}</t>
freshness.silentWhy: Meanwhile {{host}} is read at the normal pace.
